text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm out and about with Mejiro

McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, look at that, Trainer. What an
adorable little
plushie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Mejiro McQueen's gaze and see

Umamusume plushies on display as
prizes for a
claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen seems to have really
taken a
shine to them. She stares
intently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-no, of course not. I was merely a bit
intrigued
by it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this game looks difficult. I
wouldn't be
able to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
